summary: Open WebUI commits no benchmark, eval or results files and no performance harness: there are no bench/ or evals/ directories, the backend has no test files, and the release-candidate suite runs from the external open-webui/tests repository. Its quantitative statements about its own performance are CHANGELOG release notes linked to pull requests, such as one-word chat search 'about 40% faster' (0.12.1), JSON that encodes 'about 17 times' and decodes 'about 3 times faster' with orjson (0.12.0), a slim image 'around 175 MB, near enough 89% smaller' (0.11.4) and document processing '10-50x' faster with parallel embedding requests (0.6.37), none with data or a reproduction method in the repository.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
